# curious about

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:curiousAbout`](gmeow-curiousAbout.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/curiousAbout>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/cognition`](../../slices/cognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An exploratory, knowledge-seeking orientation toward a subject — interest aimed at closing a knowledge gap. A specialization of [`gmeow:interestedIn`](gmeow-interestedIn.md) (curiosity is interest with an epistemic appetite). Still an attentional pull, not a teleology:Desire ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for interest with an epistemic appetite — a knowledge-seeking orientation aimed at closing a gap — when the curiosity flavour matters beyond plain [`gmeow:interestedIn`](gmeow-interestedIn.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for sustained interest with no epistemic drive (use the parent [`gmeow:interestedIn`](gmeow-interestedIn.md)), for actual attained knowledge (the [`gmeow:isAwareOf`](gmeow-isAwareOf.md) … [`gmeow:hasMastered`](gmeow-hasMastered.md) spectrum), and for a goal (teleology); curiosity is still an attentional pull, not a conative mode ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:curiousAbout`](gmeow-curiousAbout.md) from agent to subject; it entails [`gmeow:interestedIn`](gmeow-interestedIn.md) by subproperty, and pairs naturally with the knowledge spectrum to model an agent curious about a subject it is only [`gmeow:isAwareOf`](gmeow-isAwareOf.md).
